usedFor: DitCal holds your bookings, and Sangam CRM receives each booker as a lead through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in DitCal, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Whoever books a slot lands in Sangam CRM as a lead, matched by ID, email or phone.

watchOut: “Booking Cancelled” and “Meeting Rescheduled” also run this action, so a lead can be updated again after a change.
